steps.title: Cross-Domain Intelligence service: port Domain + PersonalIntelligence classes into a real, callable service
steps.task: Create services/cross-domain-intelligence-service.js exporting the Domain and PersonalIntelligence classes -- a deterministic port of the already-proven prototype scripts/prototype-cross-domain-v5.mjs (12/12 tests). No AI/model call anywhere in this file (question-matching is keyword-based, same as the prototype). Do not include the prototype's self-test auto-execution code or its dotenv/assert imports.
non_goals: real calendar/finance/health data source integration -- fusion/consent/inference logic only, in-memory records
any AI/model call -- this must remain deterministic like the proven prototype
wiring into any live product surface
redesigning the domain policy shape or consent model
